name: Kepora Gebora
description: An owl-like NPC who provides guidance to the player.

fields.name: Text ID
fields.description: The ID of the text displayed by the actor. The stored value is increased by 299 before being used as the text ID.

fields.name: Start on Branch
fields.description: If enabled, Kepora Gebora starts on the branch. Otherwise, the player must approach him before he flies down.

fields.name: Player Detection Range
fields.description: Sets the range used to search for the nearest eligible player. The value is adjusted and clamped before being used as the search radius.

fields.name: Room Flag
fields.description: The room flag checked to determine Kepora Gebora's behavior and set during certain state transitions. A value of 0 disables the room flag check.

fields.name: Additional Effect
fields.description: Enables an additional actor effect when the internal mode is 0 or 3.

fields.name: Special Mode
fields.description: Enables special behavior when the relevant global conditions are met. This affects Kepora Gebora's initial state and dialog flow.
